breakdown.description: Thin airfoil theory (linear small-angle model) is applied at a large angle of attack where stall/nonlinear effects dominate.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. It followed the user's flawed instruction to apply thin airfoil theory (a linear model) at a large 20-degree angle of attack. While it correctly noted that this is beyond the theory's validity range, it still proceeded with the incorrect calculation. The ground truth correctly instructs to either use a small angle appropriate for the theory or use a different, more suitable model for the large angle. The agent executed the flawed request instead of correcting it.
